body.summary: Trim tab take-off settings do not match my aircraft's placard.
body.as_written: Rudder trim tab knob — 3 DEGREES RIGHT
body.should_say: Confirm against the aircraft placard; mine differs after the trim system rework.
body.detail: This airframe was rebuilt with a different rudder trim arrangement and carries a placard giving a different take-off setting. The 1958 handbook value is not correct for it. Flagging as a variation rather than an error, since the file does match its stated source.
